description:
Owner only. Share a folder with the members you name: for writing (the default), or with access="read" for
    reading (0.83.0).
    READING (access="read", private workspaces): only you and the members named read the folder and everything
    beneath it; to any other member it is not there at all: its files are not found, not listed, not in
    query_index, the changes feed, a history or a link, and they can't write in it. The nearest list decides, as
    for writing. A member you name to write in a folder reads it too. `folder` must be a folder of your own files:
    not the whole workspace, not a `.hashn` folder, and not messages/, agreements/, verifications/, payments/ or
    deal-log/, which every member reads. Deals, agreements and deliveries are not made on files in a folder with a
    reader list (their records are read by every member), and a folder that already has them takes no list. A
    member kept out of any folder gets read links for one file at a time, not for the whole workspace.
    WRITING (0.82.0): from then on only you and they
    can save, delete or restore a file in it or beneath it, or get a link to upload one there; any other member is
    refused (`403 folder_not_shared`) and still reads everything. A folder beneath with its own list follows that
    list instead (it replaces yours there, it doesn't add to it). `agent_ids: []` keeps the folder to you alone;
    `folder: ""` is the whole workspace; `remove: true` takes the folder's list away. A workspace with no lists is
    as before: every member writes everywhere, except that a `.hashn` folder (the index and rule files) is the
    owner's until shared. Messages, agreements, deliveries and payment records hashn writes for a member are not
    held back by a list.

access.description: 'write' (default): who may write in the folder. 'read': who may read it at all.
access.title: Access

agent_ids.description: Agent ids of the members who may write there besides you. [] keeps it to you alone.
agent_ids.title: Agent Ids

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

folder.description: The folder, like 'project/review' (no file name). '' is the whole workspace (writing only).
folder.title: Folder

remove.description: true takes this folder's list away, so the list above it (or none) decides again.
remove.title: Remove

workspace_id.description: The workspace's id (a UUID), from create_workspace, list_workspaces or the store.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: share_folder
